_: Repository profiles of the shared CI (ADR-018). A profile gives a repository its default set of workflows and its speed budgets; a repository may tune them (inputs) but a workflow that pushes it over budget is the workflow's bug. Read by scripts/ci-speed.mjs (the weekly speed report) and checked by tests/ci-speed.test.mjs (every active repository of repos.json has a profile).

budgets._: Minutes of feedback, measured at the 90th percentile over seven days: first run started to last run finished for one head commit and one event.

library.for: A published package (npm, Maven Central, crates): its tests and its release.

app-web.for: A web app deployed from main: build, image, visual and accessibility checks, films from its journeys.

app-mobile.for: An Expo app: lint, types, tests side by side, Maestro journeys when the app's files changed, EAS on a tag.

app-desktop.for: A Tauri app: the check and the unsigned build on a pull request, signing on main or a tag only.

java-service.for: A Spring service: Maven verify, its image (buildpack), SonarCloud.

worker.for: A Python or GPU worker: lint and tests side by side; the image only when its files changed.

site.for: A public site: build and SEO contract before the merge, the live checks after the deploy.

docs.for: A documentation site built from its repository: build, links, SEO.

infra.for: OpenTofu modules: fmt, validate, test; never apply from CI.
